_about: Frozen labeled development cases for the WEL-43 sentence-integrity comparison. Each text is already-extracted text (what evidence_text holds), not HTML. 'support'/'problem' are the ground truth for the air_fryer_basket_after_each_use@1 registry sentences: true means a reader sees that exact reviewed sentence as one complete sentence in this text. Escapes keep this file ASCII: \u00a0 is a non-breaking space, \u200b a zero-width space.

cases.name: clean_whole_sentence
cases.why: Both reviewed sentences appear as complete sentences on their own lines.
cases.text:
How to clean an air fryer basket
This may surprise you more than how much your appliance can tackle, but air fryer baskets need to be cleaned after every use.
Regular cleaning helps prevent grease buildup, lingering odors, and stuck-on food that can make cleanup even harder the next time you cook.
Use a soft sponge and warm water.

cases.name: split_by_block_break
cases.why: One sentence interrupted by an inline block tag arrives as two lines; a reader still sees one whole sentence.

cases.name: negated_prefix
